## About

This repository contains the official container images for Azure CLI Extension List Publisher. 

It automatically creates PR to update the document listing the available CLI extensions in https://github.com/azure/azure-docs-cli.

## Featured Tags

- `0.3.0` ```docker pull mcr.microsoft.com/azure-cli-ext/ext-list-publisher:0.3.0``` 

## Usage

```
docker run \
    --rm \
    -e TRAVIS_BUILD_ID=$TRAVIS_BUILD_ID \
    -e TRAVIS_REPO_SLUG=$TRAVIS_REPO_SLUG \
    -e TRAVIS_COMMIT=$TRAVIS_COMMIT \
    -e GH_TOKEN=$GH_TOKEN \
    -e DOC_REPO_SLUG=$DOC_REPO_SLUG \
    -e REPO_LOCATION=/repo \
    -v $PWD:/repo \
    mcr.microsoft.com/azure-cli-ext/ext-list-publisher:0.3.0
```

## Support
